reference_type: independently executed original standard-method result; no independent microstructure truth

baseline.method: Fresh explicit multi-compartment SMT versus unmodified original on exact full CFIN observations

nrmse_definition: RMS error divided by max(reference)-min(reference), over every fixed observation-mask voxel, separately for each required field.
support: Public fixed input-only observation_mask; exact zero padding outside. No scale, axis, intensity or field alignment.
threshold_provenance: Frozen before local inverse in private prelocal_full_gate.json: measured source64/source32 and float32 nextafter envelopes, all four quantities; no threshold adjusted to fit local results.
